conviction_note: Small positive lean (p_up 57 on an abs move of 7.0, giving +0.98). The bar is IFIS's FY operating-profit consensus of 56.9bn yen, already 5% under the company's 60bn plan and cut 5% in four weeks. Q2 (Jun-Aug) yen averages ran 11-16% weaker than the company's Jun-Feb assumption, and on the company's own FX sensitivities that roughly covers the 2.5bn Q1 system-migration loss. So a held or barely-trimmed plan, the most likely outcome, would be a relief against the street. That lean is held near 50 for three reasons: the name has sold 8 of its last 11 prints, the 信用倍率 is 26.8 (crowded margin longs), and the release lands into an AI/semis sell-off and a three-day weekend. The finding sum (+1.5) and the scaled number (+0.98) agree in sign; the sum is larger because the FX finding is sized at its own worth, not divided down.
bar: IFIS consensus FY2027/2 (Feb-27) as of 2026-10-08: revenue 590,051m, operating profit 56,858m, pretax 60,506m, against the company plan of 580,000 / 60,000 / 65,000 (unchanged since 2026-04-10). The pretax consensus was 63,890 four weeks earlier and 62,056 one week earlier. Source: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6506. Pre-Q1 IFIS (2026-07-09): FY OP 67,497, H1 OP 32,900, Q2 OP 17,217, from https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6506_20260710_act_20260710_160021_2. print_vs_bar is my estimate of the FY operating-profit guide the company carries out of this release (~58.5-60bn) against the 56.9bn consensus.
positioning_check: JPX short register 2026-09-29: 0.0% disclosed (no position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 pts, so no squeeze fuel and no informed shorts building. 信用倍率 26.79 (baseline, broker scrape): margin longs heavily crowded after a ~32% drawdown from the 7,479 yen high of 2026-07-03 to a low near 4,300 in mid-September. No options, so no skew. Baseline priced_lean -1.07 (margin overhang -0.71, run-up -0.36). Run-up: +7.1% over 20 days and -0.7% over 5 days; sealed spot 4,773, trading 4,735 at 10:11 JST on 10/09 in an AI/semis sell-off. Sell-side: 11 of 14 analysts rate it a buy, with a 6,251 yen average target (kabuyoho reportTarget). Targets were cut by GS (9000->5500, 9/25), MS (7500->6100, 9/25), Nikko (8100->6700, 8/28) and SBI (7000->6250, 10/2); Macquarie raised to 6,200 on 10/7.

findings.finding: Q2 FX ran far weaker than the company's assumption. Jun-Aug 2026 averaged USD/JPY 160.7, EUR/JPY 184.9 and CNY/JPY 23.76, against the company's unchanged Jun-Feb assumption of 145 / 170 / 20.5. On the company's own published FY OP sensitivities per 1% (USD 3.8bn yen x0.1, i.e. 0.38bn; EUR 0.10bn; CNY 0.35bn; KRW 0.15bn), that is roughly +2.5-3.0bn of Q2 operating profit above plan. If H2 is re-marked even to ~150-155, a further ~3-4bn follows. Together that covers the ~2.5bn Q1 production loss the company quantified, and leaves room to hold the 60bn OP plan against a street at 56.9bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance changes have driven this name's largest reactions. FY OP raised 43->48bn at the 2025-10-03 Q2 print: +19.3% next session (also a strong market day). Cut 60->43bn on 2025-07-04: -10.3%. Q1 miss with the plan held on 2026-07-10: -14.3% (stop-low area). Q2-print revision record: 2023 held, 2024 cut (OP 70->64bn), 2025 raised (kabuyoho revision history).
findings.why_not_priced: Analysts model spot FX, so the FX gain itself is in the 56.9bn consensus. What is not priced is the company's own decision. In Q1 it kept 145 yen despite a 158.8 actual and said it would 'carefully watch' the system migration before revising. The street has cut 5% in four weeks, and four houses cut targets since late August, which is pricing a downward revision. If the market expected the plan to be held, consensus would sit near 60bn rather than 5% below it and still falling. The company's own FX arithmetic gives it room to hold, or to trim less than the street did.
findings.independence: FX averages from the Yahoo chart series (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/JPY=X?range=6mo&interval=1d, EURJPY=X, CNYJPY=X), an independent source from the company sensitivity table. Q1 Q&A (https://www.yaskawa.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/261Q_QA_1.pdf): Q2+ sales of just under 150bn per quarter at plan FX, ~156bn at Q1 actual rates; utilisation to rise from <75% in Q1 to 85-90% in Q2.

findings.finding: Demand from counterparties and series reported since Yaskawa last spoke is strong. Japan machine-tool orders were +50.4% y/y in July and +65.4% in August (the fastest since Oct 2021; servos go into machine tools). Rorze, a Feb-year-end semiconductor wafer-handling robot maker, raised its FY pretax profit 44% on 2026-10-08 on semiconductor demand, with sales 13.2% above plan. Yaskawa itself guided Q2 orders at Q1's record level for both servo and robots.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Record orders in Q1 (+29% y/y) did not stop a -14.3% reaction on 2026-07-10, when profit and production missed. This name has sold good order prints when the profit line disappointed.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the series are public, and consensus revenue (590bn) already sits above the company's 580bn. What may not be priced is a Q2 order print that again beats the record while the sector trades on AI capex fear (SOX -3% on 10/08). Kept small for that reason.
findings.independence: Rorze upgrade: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6506&b=n202610081073 (2026-10-08). Company Q2 order guide: https://www.yaskawa.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/261Q_QA_1.pdf. Three different sources pointing the same way.

findings.finding: The company said in July that production would be roughly normal by July and stable in August. SBI Securities (2026-10-02, via kabutan 10/05) reports that servo-motor production normalisation slipped into Q3, and cuts FY OP to 52.5bn against the 60bn plan. So Q2 operating profit likely undershoots the pre-Q1 Q2 consensus of 17.2bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The production/system-migration miss at Q1 (2026-07-10) brought -14.3% the next session. That was the first time the market saw it; this time it is already in broker notes.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is in a widely circulated broker note, IFIS consensus has been cut 5% in four weeks, and GS, MS, Nikko and SBI cut targets. What remains is the setup the definition flags: 信用倍率 26.8 means a visible miss still has trapped margin longs to sell into it.
findings.independence: Company's own July statement of the expected recovery timeline (https://www.yaskawa.co.jp/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/261Q_QA_1.pdf), contradicted on timing by the SBI note. Target cuts: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6506&b=n202609251102. These are different sources, but the same underlying fact.

outside_window.finding: Capacity step-up in H2: robot plant No.5 in full operation from July, servo capacity planned +30-40% over H1, semiconductor-robot output +30-40%. This drives H2 earnings and FY2028/2 (SBI 72.5bn OP, a record), but it resolves through later quarters.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: likely at this print (Q1 kept the plan explicitly pending the migration; Q2 revisions in 2024 down and 2025 up). The street sits at 56.9bn OP against the 60bn plan, so holding or trimming to ~58bn is a relief, and below ~55bn is a miss. Returns: no buyback signal, interim dividend 36 yen planned. Not a full-year print, so no new-year guide. Q1 progress was 14% of FY OP (13.1% of pretax) against 19.5% at Q1 last year; H1 progress would need ~40% to look normal (last year 49.9% of pretax at H1).

baseline_tension: Mildly cuts against the baseline's priced lean (-1.07, driven by the margin overhang and the 20-day run-up). The strongest positive this release could carry is a held 60bn OP plan with FX re-marked, against a street at 56.9bn and falling; I looked for it, and the company's own FX sensitivities support it. I also looked for a buyback (precedent at the Q2 2024 print) and found no signal. The crowded margin long and the name's habit of selling prints are why p_up stays at 57 rather than 60+.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the production-slip finding rests on a public broker note already reflected in IFIS cuts and target cuts, so it was resized from -1.0 to -0.5, and its weight in p_up was reduced (p_up 56 -> 57, expected move +0.84 -> +0.98)
Rule 2 (check the sign; look for the strongest positive): already done before reading the file (held forecast, buyback, dividend all checked); recorded in baseline_tension; nothing further moved
The FX/guidance and demand findings were left as they were
